comparison.objective: Run a controlled gravity-ramp experiment to identify the higher-friction sled and place it on a mat; the candidate iteratively tunes a damper to an acceptable stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests arranging sleds, pressing a release button, observing stopping distance, and selecting and relocating a specimen. Candidate tests hex-key use, fastener torque, collar adjustment, counterholding, and guarded repeated cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires two valid releases with stopping-distance difference over 30 mm and only the higher-friction sled on the mat. Candidate requires two consecutive stops without bottoming, hard-stop contact, excessive rebound, overload, or lock drift.
comparison.reason: Both observe physical stopping behavior, but the record tests comparative material identification while the candidate tests closed-loop adjustment and mechanical locking of one component. Candidate omits numeric rebound, overload, and collar-drift thresholds.
